profile.name: Md Ether Deowan
profile.title: PhD Candidate in Field Robotics
profile.department: Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering
profile.tagline: Navigation, perception, and decision autonomy for underwater and field robotic systems.
bio: Md Ether Deowan is a PhD candidate in the Field Robotics Lab at the Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), where he researches navigation and decision autonomy for underwater and field robotic systems.

He holds a BSc in Electrical and Electronics Engineering and an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master's in Marine and Maritime Intelligent Robotics, with study tracks at the University of Toulon and Jaume I University.
His work spans AI-driven perception, sensor fusion, robot control, multi-robot coordination, industrial automation, and human–robot collaboration.

researchThemes.title: Underwater robot autonomy
researchThemes.description: Robust navigation and decision-making for underwater vehicles operating with uncertain sensing and limited communication.

researchThemes.title: Multimodal perception and sensor fusion
researchThemes.description: Combining sonar, vision, Doppler, inertial, and other sensing modalities for localisation, mapping, and safe control.

researchThemes.title: Learning and model-based control
researchThemes.description: Reinforcement learning, predictive control, dynamic modelling, and hybrid autonomy for robotic systems.

experience.summary: Researching navigation and decision autonomy for underwater and field robotic systems under the supervision of Professor Eleni Kelasidi.

experience.organization: Laboratoire d’Informatique et Systèmes, University of Toulon
experience.summary: Investigated predictive control and dynamic modelling for chains of underwater robots and passive cable sections.
Developed reinforcement-learning and sensor-fusion methods for real-time underwater navigation.
Developed robotic manipulation systems, perception pipelines, and MATLAB-based real-time simulations.
Led PLC, HMI, industrial automation, and power-electronics integration projects.
Designed protection, control, measurement panels, and electrical schematics for industrial systems.

projects.title: Autonomous Underwater Black Box Retrieval Using BlueROV2
projects.description: A modular ROS 2 and Unity system combining ArUco-based detection, PD depth control, and behavior-tree decision logic for autonomous underwater retrieval.
projects.imageAlt: Architecture connecting the Unity simulator, ROS middleware, and the physical BlueROV2

projects.title: Advancing Map-less Underwater Navigation
projects.description: A comparative investigation of A2C, PPO, and TRPO with multimodal sensor fusion and reward design for resilient low-cost underwater navigation.

projects.title: UR5 Robot Control and Object Manipulation
projects.description: A UR5e and Robotiq 3-Finger Gripper framework using YOLO perception, inverse kinematics, trajectory planning, and MoveIt 2 for adaptive grasping.

projects.title: Autonomous TurtleBot3 Navigation in a Maze
projects.description: Multi-robot simulation with 2D SLAM, ROS 2 Navigation, custom Gazebo environments, and synchronized behaviors triggered by external signals.

projects.title: Dynamical Modelling of SCARA and Hexabot Robots
projects.description: Kinematic and dynamic analysis using Denavit–Hartenberg parameters, homogeneous transforms, Jacobians, singularity analysis, MATLAB, and Simulink.

projects.title: Texture Classification and Semantic Analysis in Abstract Art
projects.description: CLIP-based texture classification, sentiment analysis of viewer annotations, and correlation analysis between visual texture and emotional response.

projects.title: Industry 4.0 Remote Monitoring and Control
projects.description: A secure remote industrial-control and analytics system using Siemens S7-1200, OPC, Node-RED, Raspberry Pi, MySQL, and Grafana.

projects.title: Epson LQ310 Integration with Siemens S7-1200

projects.title: Simplex 5 Series Conversion to a PLC System

projects.title: IoT Air-Pollution Monitoring and Forecasting
projects.description: A real-time air-quality platform measuring particulate matter, gases, temperature, humidity, and pressure for monitoring and forecasting.

projects.title: Railway Ticket Generator
projects.description: Python and SQL software for ticket booking, passenger information, and transaction management.

projects.title: UWB Microwave Imaging for Lung Anomaly Detection
projects.description: Simulation and imaging research using anatomical models to investigate non-invasive detection of lung-fluid anomalies.
